messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — HelixThera asked for a hands-on enablement session next week focused on Dedicated migration and cost/perf tuning. They want a lab + 30m Q&A. Can we slot something?

jake-ae: thanks for flagging. What timezone are their engineers in?

maria: Primary overlap is CET and PDT (they have APAC observers). Ideally we run two repeats: one US-friendly and one EU-friendly.

emma-cs: i'm available Wed 10:00 PT / Thu 18:00 CET. prefer morning PT though.

diane-eng: i can cover the runtime deep dive and quantization notes, prefer Thu CET.

lee-poc: HelixThera confirmed Tue/Thu mornings CET. they'd like hands-on steps in a sandbox env (no access to prod). also a short pre-read.

maria: ok. proposed minimal agenda (30m lab + 30m q/a):
```
1) 10m quick checklist: account & network prep (VPC, KMS, firewall)
2) 25m guided lab: Dedicated pool sizing + baseline perf test
3) 15m optimize: batching, caching, quant profiles
4) 30m open Q&A / renewal risk discussion
```

jake-ae: can we include a 5–10 minute renewal health check at the end? flag any blockers that could affect renewals.

emma-cs: yes — i’ll prepare a 5-slide health snapshot: usage, errors, cost trends, support open items.

maria: cool. I created two tentative invites: 2024-06-12 10:00 PT and 2024-06-13 15:00 CET — calendar links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=us-session and https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=eu-session

onboarding-bot: Reminder: please attach pre-read docs to the event: https://docs.redwood.example/helix-prepare (template: network-checklist.md)

lee-poc: i'll get our sandbox creds + team list by EOD Friday. can someone drop the lab steps into the event?

diane-eng: will paste step-by-step runbook and a quick perf script.

maria: action items:
- emma: health snapshot slides (due Mon)
- diane: runbook + perf script (due Mon)
- jake: confirm renewal stakeholders to invite (due Fri)
- lee: sandbox creds + list (due Fri)

jake-ae: tagging @emma-cs and @diane-eng — thanks all. if no objections i'll finalize invites tomorrow. :thumbsup:

emma-cs: no objections.

maria: Great — final note: capture feedback after each session using tiny form (2 q's: helpful? blockers?) so we can tie to Optimize recommendations. i'll wire up a short link after session.

lee-poc: sounds good, appreciate the quick turnaround.

maria: thanks team — will follow up with finalized invites and the pre-read bundle. :rocket:
